question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Operating cash flow covered net income {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} times. That is above one, but it is the lowest of the company's profitable years in its six-year history ({earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}; the remaining year was a loss). Part of the fall is benign: depreciation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization} is small beside income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}. Accruals over total assets are {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}. They are still negative (income below cash) but the highest of the five filled years, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} a year earlier; over average assets they are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}. Working capital: trade receivables rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}, absorbing {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income. Inventory rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change}, or {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income. Trade payables supplied only {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}, or {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income. Articulation: inventory articulates exactly (gap {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}). Receivables show a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap}: the cash-flow line is larger than the change in trade receivables. The likely cause is that the line spans the wider receivables caption, which also holds government-incentive, tax and other receivables, and Python did not articulate that caption. Payables cannot be articulated because no payables cash-flow line is tagged. What offset the receivables build was liabilities booked but not yet paid. The release's reconciliation shows large inflows from three lines: other noncurrent liabilities, which the note ties to Pillar Two income taxes payable beyond twelve months; accounts payable and accrued expenses, mostly income taxes and variable compensation; and other current liabilities, mainly consideration payable to customers. These reverse when the taxes, bonuses and credits are paid. None of the three lines is a field in calculator_filings_only.json, so this analysis cannot state operating cash flow without them and writes no adjustment for them. The unpaid-tax line alone is large beside the margin by which operating cash flow exceeds net income. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, below one: over the nine quarters read, income moved less than cash. Operating cash flow fell short of net income in the second quarter ({earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.2} against {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.2}) and the third ({earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.1} against {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.1}). These are the only quarters in the window where that happened. The fourth quarter's {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.0} against {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.0} restored the cover. Customer deposits are classed as financing, so they inflate none of these ratios.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Cash backs earnings for the year, but with less margin than in the company's own past, and part of that cover is tax and compensation expensed but not yet paid. Quality is adequate rather than strong.

revenue_recognition.finding: Days sales outstanding, on the year-end balance against full-year revenue, is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}. That is the highest of five filled years, up from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}. Receivables over revenue is likewise the highest, at {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}. On average balances DSO is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. The quarterly measure has not run away: the third quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} is second highest of six and below {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}. The fourth quarter is not reached. Revenue was loaded into the exit quarter: fourth-quarter revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter} grew {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the third quarter and {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} on the year-ago quarter, against {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} for the full year. That alone raises a DSO built on a year-end balance. Management's explanation (higher revenue) fits that reading, as does the unchanged policy wording that payments are generally due shortly after delivery. The fourth-quarter DSO that would test it is not in calculator_filings_only.json, so the high stays unresolved. The fiscal year had fifty-three weeks; the prose names no effect and does not say which quarter carried the extra week. The revenue policy changed in substance, in four ways: multi-year take-or-pay strategic customer agreements with price bands, a new variable-consideration judgment; deposits that become revenue when a customer misses its minimum, which would be revenue with no shipment (none is recorded yet); a judgment that the deposits carry no significant financing component; and remaining performance obligations now measured on expected purchases rather than minimum committed volumes. Contract liabilities are {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}, or {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct} of revenue, but the tagged concept changed between years, so no trend exists. These liabilities are refundable deposits rather than deferred revenue, so they do not move against revenue in the usual sense. The consideration-payable estimate, which reduces revenue, rose steeply; see estimates. No bill-and-hold arrangement or extended payment term appears in the input.
revenue_recognition.verdict: Revenue is recognized at shipment under payment terms that did not lengthen. The year-end receivables high is unresolved rather than adverse, and the new contract structure opens judgment areas the numbers cannot yet test.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The allowance, inventory-reserve and warranty ratios are unfilled in every period, and the inventory write-down concept has no row for this year, so no reserve can be shown to be thinning or releasing. The estimate that moved most is consideration payable to customers for pricing adjustments and returns. The tagged refund liability rose from the year-earlier balance and again after the third quarter, and MD&A names it as the main cause of higher other current liabilities. A larger estimate lowers revenue now. The input does not say what pricing adjustments are owed in a year of rising prices, and a later release of the estimate would raise revenue. Inventory days on the year-end balance rose to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, third highest of five. Yet the third quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} was the lowest of six quarters. Work in process rose and finished goods fell, and no prose explains the inventory figures. A gross margin of {ratios.profitability.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of five years, leaves a wide net-realizable-value cushion today, and MD&A names no write-down or reserve release among its causes. Tax: the effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}, and Pillar Two top-up tax largely offsets the Singapore incentive. The prior-year rate is not in calculator_filings_only.json, so the stated rise cannot be checked. No valuation-allowance release or discrete benefit is described. The top-up tax is accrued but classed as noncurrent income taxes payable, a classification that keeps its cash outflow out of this year. Government incentives reduce the cost of PP&E, and so depreciation, and the incentive receivable rose along with a higher credit rate. Equipment not placed in service and construction in progress both rose. Neither is depreciated until it enters service, and the input gives no date for that. Non-marketable equity investments rose sharply and are carried under a measurement judgment. Because of the no-financing-component judgment, no interest accretes on the deposits, while the cash they brought earns interest. Goodwill: the input carries only standing text with no impairment indicator and no headroom, discount-rate or growth figures. No estimate change that raises income is described.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: No reserve release or income-raising estimate change is visible. The risks are a fast-growing pricing-adjustment liability, reserve ratios that cannot be tested and new judgments on the deposits.

cost_deferral.finding: No development cost is capitalized: no capitalized software additions are tagged in any period, and research and development of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense} is expensed. Interest is the cost being deferred. Capitalized interest rose year on year in both fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2026 while debt fell from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} to {terms.debt_now}. The release prints no interest expense in the third and fourth quarters, so in those quarters all interest incurred went into PP&E. The year's expensed interest is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense}, against interest paid of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_paid}. The capitalized amount is not in calculator_filings_only.json. It is small beside earnings, and the rise in construction in progress gives it a benign reading, but MD&A credits the lower expense to lower debt alone. The soft-asset share is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, the highest of five years, up from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share}. The formula counts marketable debt securities and receivables as soft, and those, not capitalized cost, drove most of the rise. Other noncurrent assets rose sharply, and only the non-marketable equity investments inside them are identified. Non-recurring items recur: patent license charges and losses on debt prepayments were removed from non-GAAP results in both fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2026. Patent license charges fit none of the exclusion categories the release lists. Non-GAAP net income exceeds GAAP net income in every column the release prints. The gap itself is not in calculator_filings_only.json, so whether it widened cannot be stated.
cost_deferral.verdict: Little cost is deferred. The open points are capitalized interest, the unexplained part of other noncurrent assets and recurring non-GAAP exclusions, each small beside earnings.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: No sale of receivables and no supplier-finance programme is tagged or described in the prose, so as far as the input shows neither lifts operating cash flow. Classification: customer deposits are placed in financing, which keeps them out of operating and free cash flow and is conservative for cash flow. The notes, however, say the same payments are not financing; that contradiction is recorded under cross-document reconciliation. The calculator uses gross capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} and leaves government-incentive proceeds out. So free cash flow simple of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}, or {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_over_net_income|pct} of net income, is not flattered by incentives. The input does not show whether the Taiwan fab bought for cash sits inside that capex line, and the calculator records no acquisition line ({terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}). The cash-flow lift that matters is timing. Unpaid Pillar Two top-up tax, accrued variable compensation and accrued customer credits all entered operating cash flow as rising liabilities and will leave it when paid. No field in calculator_filings_only.json carries those amounts, so no adjustment is written; this year's free cash flow should be read as flattered by them. Year-end cash of {terms.balances_now.cash} and the marketable investments beside it include deposit cash that must be repaid to customers several years from now, on the schedule the notes give. Off balance sheet: unconditional purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, with no prior-year figure to compare, and they sit beside PP&E purchase obligations and rising capex guidance. Customers have posted bank letters of credit in the company's favour, a credit support that becomes revenue only on default. Guarantee exposure and the year-end operating-lease balance are not stated for this period; the calculator's lease figure of {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability} comes from an earlier quarter. Lease special-purpose entities appear in the notes with amounts only, and no variable-interest entity is described. Share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}: {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_revenue|pct} of revenue and {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_operating_cash_flow|pct} of operating cash flow, up from {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.share_based_compensation}. It is a real cost and is already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}. Cash withheld for employee taxes on equity awards also rose, in financing.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: Factoring, supplier finance and the classification of deposits do not lift operating cash flow. It is lifted this year by unpaid tax and accrued compensation that will reverse, and no calculator field lets this analysis adjust for them.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: Both audit opinions are unqualified. Management and the auditor both report internal control over financial reporting as effective, and no fourth-quarter change in internal control is reported. The auditor has served since 1984, so there is no auditor change. The revenue critical audit matter now describes the take-or-pay agreements, but its stated basis is still auditor effort. Its listed procedures name none of these: customer deposits, contract liabilities, letters of credit, remaining performance obligations or the financing-component judgment. The 8-K filings on officer matters, dated June and August 2026, have bodies that are not in the input, so a departure of the chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller can be neither seen nor ruled out. The numbers reader reports a late-filing line that prints none and carries no id. No restatement trace exists in the input. Prior-period amounts were reclassified into the new noncurrent customer contract liabilities caption with totals unchanged, which accounts for the tag change. The new income-tax disclosure standard was adopted prospectively, a disclosure-only change. No SEC comment letter, related-party note or subsidiary-list diff is in the input. A senior officer adopted a pre-arranged share-sale plan in July 2026; that is not an accounting signal.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: Clean on everything visible. The gaps are the officer-change filings that cannot be seen and an audit matter whose procedures do not reach the new deposit accounting.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K earnings release agrees with the 10-K on every full-year figure checked: net income {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}, operating cash flow {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}, the receivables caption, long-term debt, other noncurrent liabilities and other noncurrent assets. It agrees with the third-quarter 10-Q on that quarter's net income ({ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter.inputs.before}) and gross margin ({trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.gross_margin|pct}). Its fourth-quarter revenue equals the year less the nine months ({ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}). The documents disagree in these places. The release's reclassified May column shows noncurrent customer contract liabilities larger than the total contract liability the third-quarter 10-Q tagged for the same date, while the notes say prior periods were reclassified with totals unchanged. That contradicts; a possible benign reading is that the new caption holds more than the old tag, but the input does not confirm it. Next, the notes say customer deposits are not financing, while the cash-flow statement and MD&A present them as financing inflows and significant funding. That contradicts in characterization, not in amount. Last, the release's debt-repayment line equals one tagged concept ({terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid.lines_not_added.0.value}), while the calculator's net borrowing rests on the smaller RepaymentsOfDebt tag ({terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid}); this is unresolved. The full-year loss on debt prepayments differs between the release and the debt note only by rounding. Across the notes items that carry a direction, the numbers confirm the balance-sheet and cash-flow claims: deposits, taxes payable, receivables, accrued liabilities, the pricing-adjustment liability, investments, construction, repurchases and lower debt. No number contradicts a directional claim. Forward-looking, product-level and expense-line claims stay unresolved because the numbers do not carry them.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: The release matches the filings on the headline figures. The contract-liability comparative and the financing characterization of deposits are real cross-document disagreements; neither changes reported earnings or operating cash flow.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: no write-down is recorded this year, and finished goods fell while work in process rose. Year-end inventory days rose to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, but the third quarter's were the lowest of six. With gross margin at {ratios.profitability.gross_margin|pct} the cushion is wide. Nothing found now, though a fall in memory prices would test it, and the reserve ratio cannot be computed. Purchase commitments in excess of need: unconditional purchase obligations of {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} have no prior-year figure, and the company says demand outruns supply. Nothing found, but untested against history. Customer concentration: the largest undisclosed customer's share of revenue fell from {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} for fiscal 2025 to {concentration.facts.4.value|pct} for the first half and {concentration.facts.5.value|pct} for the first nine months of fiscal 2026. The 10-K says no customer reached the disclosure threshold for the year. How the strategic agreements and their deposits are spread across customers is not disclosed. Channel stuffing: fourth-quarter revenue jumped {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the third quarter, and year-end DSO is the highest of five years. Distributor price protection is an audited estimate, and the pricing-adjustment liability rose. Against that, finished goods fell and supply is being allocated. Unresolved, with no positive sign. Circular or vendor-financed deals: non-marketable equity investments, primarily in AI and technology companies, rose sharply. The text does not say whether any investee is a customer or a party to a strategic agreement. The amounts are small beside revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}. The deposits run the other way, with customers funding the company, so they are not vendor financing.
industry_lens.verdict: No industry-specific warning is confirmed. Possible overlap between investees and customers, and the loading of revenue into the fourth quarter, stay open.

reconciliation.why: The release's financing line for customer deposits and the jump in noncurrent customer contract liabilities match the deposits the prose describes. Contract liabilities stand at {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}.

The release cash-flow statement carries the deposits under financing, as MD&A says, and free cash flow simple of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} excludes them. The conflict with the notes' statement that the payments are not financing is recorded as a separate anomaly.

No debt was issued ({terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued}), and debt fell from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} to {terms.debt_now}. The release shows deposit proceeds and higher government-incentive proceeds, so funding came from deposits and incentives, as stated.

The year-end build in contract liabilities to {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} fits agreements signed in the third and fourth quarters. Whether more agreements follow is a forward claim that no number here can test.

Shipments by customer are not in the numbers. The largest undisclosed customer's share fell to {concentration.facts.5.value|pct} for the first nine months of fiscal 2026 from {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} for fiscal 2025, which fits allocation away from some customers but does not prove it.
Business-unit bit shipments and revenue are in neither calculator_filings_only.json nor the numbers report.

Product-level revenue, prices and bit shipments are not in the numbers. Consolidated revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} and gross margin reached {ratios.profitability.gross_margin|pct}, which fits a price-led rise without confirming the split by product.
As for DRAM: consolidated revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} fits the claim, but NAND revenue, prices and bits are not in the numbers.

Gross margin is {ratios.profitability.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of five years, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.gross_margin|pct} a year earlier, so the direction is confirmed. The attribution to price cannot be tested, and with no inventory write-down row for this year a reserve release is neither shown nor excluded.

R&D for the year is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}, but the prior-year amount is not in calculator_filings_only.json, so the rise cannot be checked. Share-based compensation rose to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} from {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.share_based_compensation}, consistent with higher compensation.
SG&A is not in calculator_filings_only.json, so the stated rise cannot be checked.

Debt fell from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} to {terms.debt_now}, and the release prints full-year interest expense well below the prior year; expensed interest is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense}. Rising capitalized interest also lowered the expense, which the prose does not name. Interest income is not in the numbers.
The effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}. The prior-year rate is not in calculator_filings_only.json, so the direction cannot be checked.
Tax expense is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense}. Neither the incentive component nor the top-up component is in the numbers.

The release balance sheet shows other noncurrent liabilities up sharply, and its cash-flow reconciliation shows a large inflow from them. Both match the note's rise in noncurrent income taxes payable.

Trade receivables rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} as revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, so the direction is confirmed. Receivables outgrew full-year revenue: year-end DSO is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the highest of five years. Fourth-quarter revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} is what would carry the explanation, but the test for it, a fourth-quarter DSO, is not computed. That gap is recorded as an unresolved anomaly.

The tagged refund liability rises from the year-earlier balance, and the release's other-current-liabilities line is an inflow, as MD&A says. Why pricing adjustments are owed in a year of rising prices is not answered.

Trade payables moved little ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}), while the release's accounts-payable-and-accrued-expenses line is a large inflow. The lift therefore sits in accrued taxes and compensation, as stated.
Both the tag for equity securities without readily determinable fair value and the release's purchase line rise, as stated.
The release's reconciliation removes a patent license charge in the fourth-quarter column, and other operating expense jumps in that quarter on the income statement.

Debt fell from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} to {terms.debt_now}, with repayments of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid} on the calculator's tag and no issuance. The release's fourth-quarter prepayment loss is small, consistent with a final prepayment, and its full-year loss differs from the note's only by rounding.
Committed borrowing capacity is not in the numbers.

Capex rose to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} from {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure}, and purchase obligations stand at {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, both consistent with the guidance. The guided quarters are still in the future.

Construction in progress and equipment not placed in service both rose at year end, and PP&E rose to {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment}. The split by site is not in the numbers.
Consolidated construction in progress rose and PP&E rose to {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment}. The site-level amount is not in the numbers.
Consolidated construction in progress rose at year end. The site-level amount is not in the numbers.

Consolidated construction in progress rose at year end, and capex over depreciation is {earnings_versus_cash.capital_expenditure_over_depreciation_and_amortization}. The site-level amount is not in the numbers.

PP&E rose to {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment}, and the calculator records no business-acquisition line ({terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}), consistent with an asset purchase. Whether the price sits inside the capex line is not shown.
Consolidated construction in progress rose at year end. The site-level amount is not in the numbers.
This is a plan spanning a decade; nothing in the numbers bears on it.

Both the current government-incentive receivable and the proceeds from government incentives rose, as a higher credit rate on rising capex of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} would produce.
This is a subsequent event, and its effect lies after the year. Repurchases this year were {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases}.
The repurchase tag shows {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases}, and the release shows nothing on the programme line for fiscal 2025.
This is a forward claim. The fourth quarter's revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter} sets a high base, but no number here can see fiscal 2027.
Product-line revenue is not in the numbers. Consolidated fourth-quarter revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the third quarter.
The remaining-performance-obligation tag exists for one period only, and the third-quarter figure rested on a different basis, so no direction can be read.
The basis change cannot be separated from new agreements in a single tagged period.
The trend table measures the year over more days than a normal year, but no number isolates the extra week's revenue, cost or cash.
No amount is given and nothing in the numbers is specific to the site.
No amount is given and nothing in the numbers is specific to the site.

Dividends paid were {terms.trailing_four_quarters.dividends_paid}, above the prior-year figure the release prints, but the prose gives the rate change no direction and the declared dividend falls after the year.
Guidance concerns a quarter that has not been reported. The numbers report prints the levels without a computed comparison.

The concentration facts show the largest undisclosed customer at {concentration.facts.4.value|pct} for the first half and {concentration.facts.5.value|pct} for the first nine months of fiscal 2026, down from {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} for fiscal 2025. A full year with no customer at the disclosure threshold is consistent with that.

The release's reclassified May column shows noncurrent customer contract liabilities larger than the total contract liability the third-quarter 10-Q tagged at the same date, on which the quarterly ratio {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} rests. A reclassification with totals unchanged does not explain a noncurrent portion that exceeds the earlier total.

The notes say the deposits secure capacity rather than provide financing to the company, yet the cash-flow statement places the same cash under financing activities and MD&A calls it significant funding. The amount agrees; the characterization does not.
The release's reconciliation does remove the patent license charge in both fiscal years. The category it falls under is still not named.

anomalies.name: Cash-flow receivables change does not equal the trade-receivables balance change
anomalies.name_ko: 현금흐름표의 매출채권 변동이 재무상태표 매출채권 변동과 불일치
anomalies.what: The cash-flow statement's receivables change is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change}, against a balance-sheet change in trade receivables of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}: a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap}. The cash-flow line probably spans the wider receivables caption, which also holds government-incentive, tax and other receivables. Python articulated only trade receivables, so the gap cannot be closed here. Inventory articulates exactly ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}). Payables cannot be articulated because no payables cash-flow line is tagged.

anomalies.name: Unpaid Pillar Two top-up tax lifts operating cash flow
anomalies.name_ko: 아직 납부하지 않은 필라 투 추가세가 영업현금흐름을 끌어올림
anomalies.what: The release's reconciliation of net income to operating cash flow carries a large inflow from other noncurrent liabilities, against a small one a year earlier. The note says those liabilities include income taxes payable that rose sharply, and MD&A ties the rise to Pillar Two. Tax expensed in income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense} but not payable within twelve months lifts this year's operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}, and the lift reverses on payment. The line is large beside the margin by which operating cash flow exceeds net income. No calculator field carries it, so no adjustment can be written.

anomalies.name: Accrued taxes, compensation and customer credits lift operating cash flow
anomalies.name_ko: 미지급 세금·보상·고객 정산금이 영업현금흐름을 끌어올림
anomalies.what: Trade payables rose only {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}, yet the release's line for accounts payable and accrued expenses is a large inflow. MD&A says it is mostly income and other taxes and salaries, wages and benefits, and other current liabilities rose mainly on consideration payable to customers. Accrued variable compensation, taxes and customer credits are paid in the following period, so this year's cash conversion includes a timing benefit. Trade payable days are {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding}.

anomalies.name: Cash fell short of income in two middle quarters; earnings smoother than cash
anomalies.name_ko: 두 분기 동안 영업현금흐름이 순이익에 못 미쳤고, 이익이 현금보다 평탄함
anomalies.what: Operating cash flow fell short of net income in the second quarter of fiscal 2026 ({earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.2} against {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.2}) and in the third ({earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.1} against {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.1}). These are the only quarters of the nine read where that happened. The fourth quarter reversed it ({earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.0} against {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.0}). Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, below one, so income moved less than cash. The prose gives no quarterly cause.

anomalies.name: Year-end days sales outstanding at a five-year high
anomalies.name_ko: 연말 매출채권회전일수가 다섯 해 중 최고
anomalies.what: DSO on the year-end balance is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, up from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, and receivables over revenue is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}; both are the highest of five years. Quarterly DSO stays inside its range: the third quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} sits below {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}. Fourth-quarter revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} on the year-ago quarter, against {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} for the year, which loads the year-end balance. Management cites higher revenue, but the fourth-quarter DSO that would test this is not computed.

anomalies.name: Revenue policy adds multi-year take-or-pay agreements with price bands
anomalies.name_ko: 가격 밴드가 있는 다년 테이크오어페이 계약이 수익인식 정책에 추가됨
anomalies.what: The policy no longer says substantially all contracts are short-term at fixed prices. It adds multi-year take-or-pay strategic agreements whose prices are fixed or periodically negotiated, most of them within minimum and maximum bands. That is a new variable-consideration judgment, though recognition at the point control transfers is unchanged. The numbers cannot test how band prices are estimated. Contract liabilities stand at {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}.

anomalies.name: Retained customer deposits would be recognized as revenue without shipment
anomalies.name_ko: 고객이 최소 구매를 채우지 못하면 보증금이 출하 없이 매출로 인식됨
anomalies.what: New policy: if a customer misses its minimum purchase commitment, the company may keep all or part of the deposit and recognize the kept amount as revenue. No retention is described as having happened. The deposits, carried in contract liabilities of {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}, are not scheduled for repayment for several years, so this path to revenue with no product shipped stays open for a long time.

anomalies.name: Remaining performance obligations now measured on expected purchases
anomalies.name_ko: 잔여 수행의무 측정 기준이 예상 구매량으로 바뀜
anomalies.what: The 10-K measures remaining performance obligations on expected purchases to satisfy committed volumes. The third-quarter 10-Q measured them on minimum committed volumes, which brings management's expectation into a figure the company sets beside revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}. Only one period is tagged, so the effect of the basis change cannot be separated from new agreements. This is a disclosure change, not a change to recognized revenue.

anomalies.name: Revenue loaded into the fourth quarter of a fifty-three-week year
anomalies.name_ko: 쉰세 주 회계연도의 마지막 분기에 매출이 몰림
anomalies.what: Fourth-quarter revenue was {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter} out of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue} for the year, up {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the third quarter. The fiscal year had fifty-three weeks; the prose names no effect and does not say which quarter carried the extra week. The release prints the highest quarterly gross margin in the input for that quarter.

anomalies.name: Contract-liability concept changed, so no trend can be computed
anomalies.name_ko: 계약부채 태그가 바뀌어 추세 비교 불가
anomalies.what: Contract liabilities over revenue is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} on the total contract-liability concept. The prior year's {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} rests on the current portion only, so no change is printed. The new noncurrent caption and the reclassification of prior periods described in the notes account for the switch.

anomalies.name: Consideration payable to customers for pricing adjustments rising steeply
anomalies.name_ko: 고객에게 지급할 가격 조정 부채가 급증
anomalies.what: The estimate of consideration payable to customers, which covers pricing adjustments and returns, rose from the year-earlier balance and again after the third quarter. MD&A names it as the main cause of higher other current liabilities. A larger estimate reduces revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue} now, and a later release would raise revenue. The input does not say what pricing adjustments are owed in a year of rising prices. The auditor tests distributor price-protection adjustments.

anomalies.name: Allowance, inventory-reserve and warranty ratios unfilled in every period
anomalies.name_ko: 대손·재고·보증 충당금 비율이 모든 기간에 비어 있음
anomalies.what: No allowance amount is tagged for the year, no inventory valuation reserve or warranty accrual is tagged in any period, and the inventory write-down concept has no row for this year. Thinning of any of these reserves cannot be tested against inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} or receivables of {terms.balances_now.receivables}.

anomalies.name: Year-end inventory days up with no explanation in the prose
anomalies.name_ko: 연말 재고일수가 늘었지만 설명이 없음
anomalies.what: Inventory days on the year-end balance rose to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, third highest of five years; on average balances they are {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory}. Yet the third quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} was the lowest of six quarters. Inventory rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change}: work in process up, finished goods down. No prose gives a cause, and MD&A credits margins to price, mix and cost without naming any write-down or reserve release.

anomalies.name: Gross margin at a five-year high
anomalies.name_ko: 매출총이익률이 다섯 해 중 최고
anomalies.what: Gross margin is {ratios.profitability.gross_margin|pct}, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.gross_margin|pct} a year earlier: the highest of five years. MD&A credits price, mix and lower manufacturing cost. With no inventory write-down row for the year, a release of inventory reserves into cost of sales can be neither seen nor excluded.

anomalies.name: No financing component recognized on customer deposits
anomalies.name_ko: 고객 보증금에 유의적 금융요소를 인식하지 않음
anomalies.what: The company judges that the strategic-agreement deposits carry no significant financing component, so no interest accretes on contract liabilities of {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} and the transaction price is not adjusted. Meanwhile the deposit cash sits in cash and marketable investments that earn interest, so interest income on it enters earnings with no matching cost. The amount is not computable from the numbers.

anomalies.name: Tax rate shaped by Pillar Two top-up tax classed as noncurrent
anomalies.name_ko: 필라 투 추가세가 유효세율을 좌우하고 비유동 부채로 분류됨
anomalies.what: The effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct} on pretax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income}. Pillar Two top-up tax largely offsets the Singapore incentive, and the top-up is held as noncurrent income taxes payable. The prior-year rate is not in calculator_filings_only.json, so the stated rise cannot be checked. No valuation-allowance release or discrete benefit is described.

anomalies.name: Government incentives rising and reducing asset cost
anomalies.name_ko: 정부 보조금이 늘고 자산 원가를 낮춤
anomalies.what: The current government-incentive receivable and proceeds from incentives both rose, and the investment tax credit rate rose. Incentives reduce PP&E cost and so depreciation, and they are recognized when the company judges the conditions will be met. The rise matches capex of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure} a year earlier. A newly issued grants standard is not expected to matter.

anomalies.name: Equipment not in service and construction in progress rising
anomalies.name_ko: 가동 전 설비와 건설중자산이 증가
anomalies.what: Equipment not placed into service and construction in progress both rose at year end. Neither is depreciated until it enters service, and the input gives no date for that. Capex over depreciation is {earnings_versus_cash.capital_expenditure_over_depreciation_and_amortization}. The fab-construction prose explains the build.

anomalies.name: Non-marketable equity investments rising under a measurement judgment
anomalies.name_ko: 시장성 없는 지분 투자가 측정 판단 아래 급증
anomalies.what: Equity securities without a readily determinable fair value rose sharply, matching the release's purchase line. They are held primarily in AI and technology companies and are carried under a measurement alternative that relies on observable price changes and impairment judgment. They are small beside total assets of {terms.balances_now.assets}.

anomalies.name: Capitalized interest rising while debt falls
anomalies.name_ko: 부채가 줄었는데 자본화 이자는 증가
anomalies.what: Capitalized interest rose year on year in both fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2026 while debt fell from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} to {terms.debt_now}. The release prints no interest expense for the third and fourth quarters. Expensed interest for the year is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense} against interest paid of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_paid}. MD&A credits the lower expense to lower debt and does not name capitalization. The capitalized amount is not in calculator_filings_only.json.

anomalies.name: Soft-asset share at a five-year high; other noncurrent assets only partly explained
anomalies.name_ko: 연성자산 비중이 다섯 해 중 최고이고 기타 비유동자산은 일부만 설명됨
anomalies.what: Soft-asset share is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share} a year earlier. The formula counts marketable debt securities and receivables as soft, and those drove most of the rise. Other noncurrent assets rose sharply, and only the non-marketable equity investments inside them are identified; the rest of the increase has no breakdown in the input.

anomalies.name: Items labelled non-recurring recur in non-GAAP results
anomalies.name_ko: 일회성으로 제외한 항목이 두 해 연속 반복됨
anomalies.what: Patent license charges and losses on debt prepayments were excluded from non-GAAP results in both fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2026. Patent license charges fit none of the exclusion categories the release lists, and no note names the counterparty or says whether royalties continue. Non-GAAP net income exceeds GAAP net income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income} in every column printed. The gap is not in calculator_filings_only.json, so whether it widened cannot be stated.

anomalies.name: Customer deposits held in financing, outside operating and free cash flow
anomalies.name_ko: 고객 보증금이 재무활동으로 분류되어 영업·잉여현금흐름에서 제외됨
anomalies.what: Deposits received under strategic customer agreements are presented as financing inflows, so operating cash flow and free cash flow simple of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} exclude them. That presentation is conservative for cash flow. The deposits must be repaid to customers several years from now, so the cash and marketable investments at year end, including cash of {terms.balances_now.cash}, hold money owed back to customers.

anomalies.name: Unconditional purchase obligations with no prior-year comparison
anomalies.name_ko: 무조건부 구매 약정에 전년 비교치가 없음
anomalies.what: Unconditional purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, but no prior-year balance is in the record. They sit beside PP&E purchase obligations and capex guidance that rises from this year's {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure}. The company says demand outruns supply, so no excess commitment is visible, but no history test is possible.

anomalies.name: Customer letters of credit off balance sheet
anomalies.name_ko: 고객이 제공한 신용장이 재무상태표 밖에 있음
anomalies.what: Certain customers keep bank letters of credit in the company's favour, which are its maximum proceeds on default or breach. They are off balance sheet and become revenue only on default: another route to revenue with no shipment, alongside retained deposits. None is described as drawn. Revenue for context is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation rising
anomalies.name_ko: 주식보상비용 증가
anomalies.what: Share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.share_based_compensation} a year earlier. That is {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_revenue|pct} of revenue and {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_operating_cash_flow|pct} of operating cash flow. Cash withheld for employee taxes on equity awards also rose, in financing. The cost is already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}. The prose ties higher compensation expense to variable pay.

anomalies.name: Cash purchase of the Taiwan fab: cash-flow line not shown
anomalies.name_ko: 대만 팹 현금 인수가 현금흐름표 어느 줄에 있는지 불명
anomalies.what: The company bought a wafer fab for cash and disclosed it in the PP&E note, not as a business combination. The calculator records no acquisition line ({terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}). If the price sits inside capex of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure}, free cash flow carries it. If it sits on a separate investing line, free cash flow simple leaves it out. The input does not say which.

anomalies.name: Revenue audit matter does not name the new deposit accounting
anomalies.name_ko: 핵심감사사항이 새 보증금 회계를 다루지 않음
anomalies.what: The revenue critical audit matter now describes the take-or-pay agreements, but its basis remains auditor effort. Its procedures (reading agreements, testing invoices and credit memos, confirming receivables, testing distributor price protection) do not name customer deposits, contract liabilities of {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}, letters of credit, remaining performance obligations or the financing-component judgment. The input does not show whether the agreement-reading procedure is new.

anomalies.name: Officer-change 8-K filings not in the input
anomalies.name_ko: 임원 변경 8-K 본문이 입력에 없음
anomalies.what: The 8-K index lists officer-matter filings dated before the year end whose bodies are not in the input. A departure of the chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller can be neither seen nor ruled out. A senior officer's pre-arranged share-sale plan is disclosed separately and is not an accounting signal. The numbers do not bear on this; revenue for context is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}.

anomalies.name: Release's May contract-liability comparative exceeds the 10-Q total
anomalies.name_ko: 실적 발표의 오월 말 계약부채 비교치가 10-Q 총액보다 큼
anomalies.what: The 8-K release's balance sheet reclassifies the May column to show noncurrent customer contract liabilities larger than the total contract liability the third-quarter 10-Q tagged for the same date, the input to the quarterly ratio {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}. The notes say prior periods were reclassified with totals unchanged, which cannot make a noncurrent portion larger than the earlier total. A benign reading is that the new caption holds items the old tag did not, but the input does not say so.

anomalies.name: Deposits called not financing in the notes but presented as financing cash
anomalies.name_ko: 주석은 보증금이 금융이 아니라 하고 현금흐름표는 재무활동으로 표시
anomalies.what: The revenue note says the deposits secure capacity and supply rather than provide financing to the company, and it uses that to justify recognizing no financing component. The cash-flow statement and MD&A present the same cash as financing inflows and significant funding. The amounts agree; the characterizations conflict. The financing presentation keeps operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow} clean, while the note's characterization keeps interest out of earnings.

anomalies.name: Release debt-repayment line differs from the tag behind net borrowing
anomalies.name_ko: 실적 발표의 부채 상환액이 순차입 계산에 쓰인 태그와 다름
anomalies.what: The release prints debt repayments equal to the tagged {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid.lines_not_added.0.value}. The calculator's net borrowing uses the RepaymentsOfDebt tag of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid}, so free cash flow to equity of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity} rests on the smaller figure. The input does not explain the difference between the two tags.

anomalies.name: Debt-prepayment loss differs between release and note only by rounding
anomalies.name_ko: 채무 조기상환 손실이 실적 발표와 주석 사이에 반올림 차이만 있음
anomalies.what: The release's full-year loss on debt prepayments, the 10-K debt note's figure and the third-quarter 10-Q's nine-month figure plus the release's fourth quarter differ only by amounts consistent with rounding of quarterly figures. Debt fell from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} to {terms.debt_now}.

anomalies.name: Largest customer's share of revenue falling
anomalies.name_ko: 최대 고객의 매출 비중 하락
anomalies.what: The largest undisclosed customer's share of revenue was {concentration.facts.0.value|pct} for fiscal 2024 and {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} for fiscal 2025. It fell to {concentration.facts.4.value|pct} for the first half and {concentration.facts.5.value|pct} for the first nine months of fiscal 2026, and the 10-K says no customer reached the disclosure threshold for the year. That fits supply allocation and agreements with a number of customers. How the deposits are spread across customers is not disclosed.

anomalies.name: Equity stakes in AI companies; overlap with customers unknown
anomalies.name_ko: 인공지능 기업 지분 투자와 고객의 중복 여부 불명
anomalies.what: Non-marketable equity investments, primarily in AI and technology companies, rose sharply during the year. The text does not say whether any investee is a customer or a party to a strategic agreement, so a circular or vendor-financed sale can be neither seen nor ruled out. The amounts are small beside revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}.

anomalies.name: Fourth-quarter revenue jump alongside rising pricing credits
anomalies.name_ko: 마지막 분기 매출 급증과 가격 조정 부채 증가가 동시에 나타남
anomalies.what: Fourth-quarter revenue rose {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the third quarter, year-end DSO is the highest of five years ({trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}), and the pricing-adjustment liability rose; distributor price protection is an audited estimate. Against a channel-stuffing reading, finished goods fell and supply is being allocated among customers. The fourth-quarter DSO that would separate the two readings is not computed.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 영업현금흐름은 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배로 이익을 뒷받침하지만, 과거 흑자 연도들보다 낮고 매출채권 증가가 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct}를 흡수했습니다. 그 빈자리는 아직 내지 않은 필라 투(Pillar Two) 세금과 미지급 보상이 메웠는데, 이는 나중에 현금으로 나가야 할 항목입니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 연말 매출채권회전일수는 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 다섯 해 중 가장 높지만, 마지막 분기에 매출이 몰린 영향일 수 있고 분기 기준으로는 과거 범위 안에 있습니다. 다년 테이크오어페이 계약, 가격 밴드, 고객이 최소 구매를 채우지 못하면 보증금을 매출로 인식하는 조항 등 새로운 판단 영역이 생겼습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 대손·재고·보증 충당금 비율은 데이터가 없어 약해졌는지 검증할 수 없습니다. 가장 크게 늘어난 추정치는 고객에게 줄 가격 조정 부채인데, 가격이 오르는 해에 왜 늘었는지 설명이 없으며 유효세율은 {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}입니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 개발비 자본화는 없고 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}는 전액 비용으로 처리됩니다. 다만 부채가 줄었는데도 자본화 이자는 늘었고, 특허 라이선스 비용과 채무 조기상환 손실이 두 해 연속 비GAAP 이익에서 제외되었습니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망 금융은 보이지 않고, 고객 보증금은 재무활동으로 분류되어 영업현금흐름을 부풀리지 않습니다. 그러나 올해 영업현금흐름에는 미납 세금과 미지급 보상이 들어 있고 이를 담은 계산 필드가 없어 조정하지 못했으며, 무조건부 구매 약정은 {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}입니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 감사 의견은 적정이고 내부통제도 유효하다고 보고되었으며 감사인 교체도 없습니다. 다만 핵심감사사항이 고객 보증금 회계를 다루지 않고, 임원 변경 관련 8-K 본문이 입력에 없어 재무 책임자 교체 여부를 알 수 없습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K 실적 발표의 주요 수치는 10-K, 10-Q와 일치합니다. 다만 오월 말 비유동 고객계약부채 비교치가 10-Q의 계약부채 총액보다 크고, 주석은 보증금이 금융이 아니라고 하면서 현금흐름표는 이를 재무활동으로 표시해 서로 어긋납니다.
